neighbours.label: The endpoint of a time span after 'until': the last digit of the end year or the time
fire: The contract runs until at least 2030.
The museum stays open until 7pm tonight.
She led the school until her death in 1871.
The company is signed up until 2025.
The road stays closed until 6am on Monday.
He served as mayor until his retirement in 1966.
The offer lasts until 5pm on Friday.
quiet: She was born in 1871 in Leeds.
The road was built at 6am on Monday.
The offer arrived at 5pm on Friday.

predictions: The digit or time after 'until' reads higher than after 'in' or 'at'.
